interpretation.formalReview: The application accepted a draft for review. It does not mean that an independent semantic audit, a human, or a native Chinese editor approved it.
interpretation.currentSource: Historical outputs below retain the source version and shortcomings observed at the time. Later code fixes do not retroactively turn those outputs into successful generations.
interpretation.cohort: Pipeline007 uses three development inputs. Pipeline008 first evaluates three seeded previously unprobed inputs, then rewrites the same first apartment twice. Pipeline009 reuses those three fresh inputs after development changes.
limitations: The three fresh cases ceased to be unseen after pipeline008.
No representative held-out accuracy estimate is justified by this sample.
No weight update or new adapter training is established by these runs.
Photo evidence already present in the inputs includes assistant-reviewed observations; this audit is not a new photo recognition benchmark.

sameApartmentDiversity.method: Remove non-alphanumeric characters from Chinese bodies; Python difflib.SequenceMatcher with autojunk=False and character-trigram set Jaccard. This describes similarity, not a semantic quality score.
sameApartmentDiversity.independentReading: One rewrite largely preserves the same opening and section order. Another moves the payment section and compresses the property introduction. Titles differ mostly in token order and an unsupported completeness claim. Tags are identical.
sameApartmentDiversity.conclusion: Some actual prose variation exists, but this sample does not establish robust individual editorial diversity. Distinct strings or different apartments alone are not sufficient evidence.

sourceConflictInvestigation.structuredOrigin: The conflicting utilities=meters value was witnessed as JSON utilitiesTerms and already present in the import revision.
sourceConflictInvestigation.manualOriginNotProven: A later general confirmation revision retained the value without a utilities change; it does not establish an explicit manual fee decision.
sourceConflictInvestigation.originalAudit: No stored utility conflict or per-field condition confirmation was present in these input snapshots.
sourceConflictInvestigation.preservationDecision: Keep stored card fields unchanged. Reject a new individual brief when explicit source utilities and an existing known field disagree, with an actionable message to clarify the card.
sourceConflictInvestigation.rangeDecision: Occupancy admission ranges use a separate sourceRestrictions contract. They never overwrite the occupants budget divisor.
sourceConflictInvestigation.roomEvidenceLimit: Saved photo evidence identifies apartment-level categories and review provenance, but contains no room or brand association. It cannot establish room-specific placement.

behavior: Explicit communal bills by receipt are recognized only in a narrowly scoped payment clause, with inclusion and negation guards.
Known source-versus-field utility disagreement blocks the individual brief without changing stored fields.
Explicit apartment smoking ban is recognized despite intervening location and strictness words.
Explicit admission range reaches the typed brief separately from budget division; integration validation requires it.

The explicit payment phrase adding meters and internet produces a separate internet-extra restriction with canonical network-fee text; it changes no utility or internet field. Inclusion and missing-internet forms are excluded.

overallConclusion: Native 4B inference can produce complete item lists and typed rental facts, and the guarded workflow correctly withholds some bad drafts. The independent audit found real language, source-condition, room-placement, completeness and coverage failures that formal acceptance did not detect at earlier snapshots. Preserve those failures in the evidence, require explicit source conflict resolution, and evaluate later native reruns separately.
